description_full:
Internship opportunities!
Untuk mahasiswa/i yang sedang program magang. 🙏 bukan loker yes.

For Mave on Jakarta Office. ✅
Jalan petogogan II. Bambu Kuning. Blok A. Jaksel.

is looking for Magangers:
✨GRAPHIC DESIGNER✨

- Male/Female
- WFO
- Bachelor graduated or non-graduated are welcome
- Having sense of humor is a must
- Having skill-sets and most ultimately passion in teamwork
- Ability in using design software such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, etc is a plus

Apart from above, you will most likely be hired because:
- You are not sensitive person, you laugh a lot🥰
- Would like to embrace every places as work place🛀
- A listener, a friend👩❤️💋👨
- A tolerant (because your internship mentor will bug you with deadlines)

🍻 Submit your CV & Portfolio to info@mavemagz.com with subject: MAGANGERS and tag your friends who might be a great fit for this position🌈

Inget. Ini untuk lowongan magang ya. Bukan Loker. ✨
